'''Treve''' was the nickname of a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he fought in a [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], serving under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. As Treve was discussing their battle casualties with Kenobi inside a [[Kothlis spynet facility|Bothan Spynet facility]] on Kothlis, a group of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[remote droid]]s broke into the facility and attacked them. During the attack, Treve defended the [[General/Legends|General]] from harm, though the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Death/Legends|fell]] to [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]].

==Biography==
A [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]] nicknamed Treve was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="gambit" /> who were trained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to be [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="databank" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="annual" /> Treve was sent to the planet [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] as part of a [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] to stop a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|invasion]] that was being led by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The mission proved to be difficult, mainly due to Grievous's new [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] [[Grievous's computer virus|computer virus]] that made all communication for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces&mdash;save for helmet [[Comlink/Legends|comms]]&mdash;impossible.<ref name="gambit" />

Despite this difficulty, Treve was assigned to [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] command to protect a [[Kothlis spynet facility|facility]] on Kothlis that was part of the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]]. Inside the facility, Treve reported their losses from the battle to Kenobi. During their conversation, however, a group of [[remote droid]]s breached the facility and attacked Kenobi. As he was protecting Kenobi from harm, Treve was [[Death/Legends|killed]] after receiving a number of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Laser/Legends|shot]] wounds from the [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="gambit" />

==Personality and traits==
Treve was a loyal yet cautious soldier who earned the trust of the equally cautious Obi-Wan Kenobi.<ref name="gambit" /> He stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] like all his fellow clones from Kamino.<ref name="databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Treve first appeared in the novel ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', the first book of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Clone Wars Gambit'' duology]], which was written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Miller]] and released in [[2010]].<ref name="gambit" />
